events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The Iran war is escalating, with potential implications for global markets and economies. The US and its allies are involved, and the situation is becoming increasingly complex. Oil prices are rising, and the global economy is at risk.
events.reasoning: The Iran war escalation is likely to lead to increased volatility in global markets, with potential implications for oil prices, interest rates, and the overall economy. The SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY) may benefit from safe-haven flows, while the iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond ETF (TLT) may decline due to rising interest rates.

timeFrame.note: Monitor oil prices and interest rates

events.exitStrategy: Exit when oil prices stabilize or interest rates peak

events.title: US Interest Rate Hike
events.summary: The US Federal Reserve is considering an interest rate hike to combat inflation. The decision will have implications for the US economy and global markets.
events.reasoning: An interest rate hike by the US Federal Reserve will likely lead to a decline in long-term bond prices, making short-term bonds more attractive. The Vanguard Short-Term Bond ETF (BSV) may benefit, while the iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond ETF (TLT) may decline.
